title: The Alchemist
description:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
The Alchemist is a new character with a high-risk, high-reward playstyle. You'll benefit from having low HP, but also be equipped with tools to gain that health back through Regen and potions. You can Enchant cards in combat to give them powerful effects, multiple times. You can also brew potions at rest sites and, more importantly, [i]sell them to the Merchant![/i] 💰

[i](Disclaimer: This description was paid for by the Merchant.)[/i]

[h2]Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🐸 A new character meticulously designed to fit in with the rest of the game
[*] ✨ 97 new cards, including 4 multiplayer cards and 2 full-art Ancient rewards
[*] 💎 9 new relics
[*] 🧪 6 new potions
[*] 🪄 3 new enchantments
[*] 📚 7 timeline epochs inspired by the hermetic Great Work
[*] 💬 Loads of dialog with Ancients and other characters
[*] 🎨 Hand-drawn artwork for all cards, relics, potions, and icons [i](WIP)[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Mechanics and Keywords[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Poison & Regen[/b]: The Alchemist deliberately self-poisons, then converts Poison into Regen, and Regen into damage, Block or other useful effects. Both are meant to be actively cycled, not passively endured.
[*] [b]Reaction[/b]: Cards with this keyword gain an extra effect when the card you played directly before them, on the same turn, matches the condition shown.
[*] [b]Gambit[/b]: Cards with this keyword have buffs that are only active while your HP is 50% or less. Whether increasing damage or adding additional effects, you'll benefit from playing strategically.
[*] [b]Ferment[/b]: This keyword is only found on cards that also Retain. These effects grow in potency for every turn the card stays in your hand. However if you Retain them past their peak, they spoil into Toxic cards.
[*] [b]Infuse[/b]: Infusing a card Enchants it for the rest of combat based on the type. Attacks apply Poison, Skills create tokens that apply Weak and Vulnerable, Powers give Strength, and other cards gain Ethereal.
[*] [b]Brew[/b]: This new Rest Site option allows you to remove a card from your deck and procure a random potion. There are 3 new potions that can only be obtained this way.
[*] [b][i]Sell Potions![/i][/b]: Due to the quality and potency of these brews, the Merchant is willing to buy potions from you, offering Gold based on the rarity.
[/list]

[h2]A Note on Quality[/h2]
The Alchemist has been lovingly crafted to feel like a natural addition to the game. Every card, relic, and potion has been (and will continue to be) balanced against the existing pools through many rounds of low and high-Ascension playtesting. The same care extends to flavor and lore: this character's story is woven directly into the game's existing timeline, and observant players will find more than a few threads connecting them to the world.

[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
Currently only the Beta version of the game is supported but if there is enough interest I could split off a separate release for the main branch.
Content is subject to change and feedback is welcome! The best place to discuss the mod is official Slay the Spire Discord server in the #modding-forum post.
